rosaelva-lomeli.text: Endorsed by the Río Hondo College Faculty Association.

source.title: Re-elect Rosaelva Lomeli, Rio Hondo College Board: Endorsements

rosaelva-lomeli.text: Credits prudent budgeting and strong reserves for the college's Moody's upgrade to Aa1; pledges to 'protect the college's financial reserves' and ensure taxpayer and student dollars are spent responsibly.

source.title: Re-elect Rosaelva Lomeli, Rio Hondo College Board: Issues

rosaelva-lomeli.text: Says she took part in the initial planning for Río Hondo's first student housing project and will keep pushing to expand basic-needs resources, student housing and academic support.

source.title: Re-elect Rosaelva Lomeli, Rio Hondo College Board: Issues

rosaelva-lomeli.text: Helped launch the High Road Training Partnership; will continue 'expanding partnerships with local employers and unions so that a Río Hondo education leads directly to a good-paying career close to home.'

source.title: Re-elect Rosaelva Lomeli, Rio Hondo College Board: Issues

rosaelva-lomeli.text: Supported passage of Measure RH and wants stronger transfer counseling and more transfer-track courses to the UC and CSU systems.

source.title: Re-elect Rosaelva Lomeli, Rio Hondo College Board: Issues

manuel-urteaga.text: Endorsed by the California School Employees Association, Rio Hondo Chapter 477, and the TRI Counties Democratic Club.

source.title: Manuel Urteaga for Rio Hondo College Board: Endorsements

manuel-urteaga.text: "I am committed to ending wasteful spending, unnecessary delays, and poor oversight in Rio Hondo College's building program by ensuring every taxpayer dollar is spent wisely." Pledges strong oversight of the $442 million Measure RH bond.

source.title: Manuel Urteaga for Rio Hondo College Board: Candidate Statement

manuel-urteaga.text: Says students 'deserve leadership focused on their interests, not special interests' and that taxpayers deserve to know how their money is spent.

source.title: Manuel Urteaga for Rio Hondo College Board: Platform

manuel-urteaga.text: Will advocate for more course offerings, improved aging facilities, stronger career and technical education, and partnerships with local businesses to prepare students for high-demand careers.

source.title: Manuel Urteaga for Rio Hondo College Board: Candidate Statement
